Servo amplifier alarms and warnings (MR-J4)

The code in the Servo alarm column of Axis Settings is the number on the servo amplifier's display: 16.3 is alarm 16, detail 3. This page is the part of the MR-J4 troubleshooting manual for that code.

CAUTION (from the manual). When any alarm has occurred, eliminate its cause, ensure safety, and deactivate the alarm before restarting operation. If [AL. 25 Absolute position erased] occurs, always make home position setting again. As soon as an alarm occurs, make the Servo-off status and interrupt the main circuit power.
Do not cycle the power repeatedly after [AL. 30 Regenerative error], [AL. 45 Main circuit device overheat], [AL. 46 Servo motor overheat], [AL. 50 Overload 1] or [AL. 51 Overload 2]. Remove the cause and allow about 30 minutes for cooling before resuming the operation.

Work down the table: check each Cause in order with its Check method; the Check result tells you the Action, or which cause to check next. Target lists the amplifier types the row applies to ([B] is the SSCNET III/H amplifier, MR-J4-_B_).

AL. F6.2 — Cam axis feed current value restoration failed

Warning F6: Simple cam function - Cam control warning
The cam axis position restoration at a time of cam control start was a failure.
The cam control is not normal.
Detail No.
Detail name
Cause
Check method
Check result
Action
Target
[A]
F6.2
Cam axis feed current value restoration failed
(1)
The difference (command unit) between the restored cam axis feed current value and the command position at cam control start is bigger than "in-position range".
Check if the difference (command unit) between the restored cam axis feed current value and the command position at cam control start is in the "in-position range".
The difference of the command position (command unit) is not within "in-position range".
Calculate the cam axis feed current value to be restored, move the command position to the position, and then start the cam control.
(For the calculation method, refer to section 12.1.3 of "MR-J4-_A_-RJ Servo Amplifier Instruction Manual (Positioning Mode)".) Or set a larger setting value to "in-position range" when the setting value is extremely small, such as 0.
